cards.audioText: Which part of the aircraft would you pay special attention to during the walk-around check if you are going to take off in extremely cold winter?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你要在极冷的冬季起飞，在绕机检查时你会特别注意飞机的哪个部分？
cards.referenceText: I will pay extra attention to the control surfaces of the aircraft and the air intakes of the aircraft engines to prevent ice accumulation in these areas.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会格外检查飞机的操纵面和飞机发动机进气道，避免这些地方产生积冰。

cards.audioText: Why is a walk-around inspection important?
cards.audioTextZh: 绕机检查为什么很重要？
cards.referenceText: A walk-around inspection can reveal fuel leaks, ice, structural damage, or foreign objects before flight. It also allows the pilot to check the engines, pitot tubes, and flight-control surfaces. Finding these problems on the ground helps prevent an in-flight malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 绕机检查可以在飞行前发现燃油泄漏、结冰、结构损伤或外来物，也使飞行员能够检查发动机、空速管和飞行操纵面。在地面发现这些问题有助于防止飞行中故障。

cards.audioText: Who is responsible for performing the preflight walk-around inspection?
cards.audioTextZh: 谁负责进行飞行前绕机检查？
cards.referenceText: The captain has overall responsibility for the walk-around inspection, although the first officer normally performs it under the company's SOP. A student pilot may carry it out under the supervision and confirmation of a flight instructor.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机长对绕机检查承担总体责任，但通常由副驾驶按照公司标准操作程序执行。学员飞行员可以在飞行教员监督和确认下完成检查。

cards.audioText: Why is it important to follow the prescribed route during a walk-around inspection?
cards.audioTextZh: 绕机检查时为什么必须遵循规定的路线？
cards.referenceText: Following a prescribed route helps the pilot inspect every required area without missing a point. A consistent sequence reduces human error, improves efficiency, and helps ensure that critical parts are checked before flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿规定路线检查，能帮助飞行员覆盖每个必检区域而不遗漏。固定顺序可以减少人为差错、提高效率，并确保飞行前检查关键部位。

cards.audioText: What route do you follow during a walk-around inspection?
cards.audioTextZh: 你进行绕机检查时遵循什么路线？
cards.referenceText: I begin at the nose, walk around the right side of the aircraft, continue around the left side, and finish back at the nose.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我从机头开始，沿飞机右侧绕行，再继续检查左侧，最后回到机头。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if a defect is found during a walk-around inspection?
cards.audioTextZh: 绕机检查中发现缺陷时，飞行员应怎么做？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should report the defect to maintenance personnel and review the Minimum Equipment List. If dispatch with the defect is permitted, the flight may proceed under the applicable conditions. If it is not permitted, the aircraft should be changed or the flight cancelled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应向维修人员报告缺陷并查看最低设备清单。如果该缺陷允许放行，航班可在适用条件下执行；如果不允许，就应更换飞机或取消航班。

cards.audioText: What requires extra attention during a walk-around inspection in extremely cold weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 在极寒天气下进行绕机检查时，哪些方面需要格外注意？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should look carefully for ice on the airframe and wings and check that the pitot tubes are not blocked. Ice on the wings can reduce lift and aircraft performance, while a blocked pitot tube can cause inaccurate cockpit indications.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应认真检查机体和机翼是否结冰，并确认空速管没有堵塞。机翼结冰会降低升力和飞机性能，空速管堵塞则会造成驾驶舱指示不准确。

cards.audioText: Which areas of an aircraft require especially careful attention during a walk-around inspection, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 绕机检查时，航空器的哪些区域需要特别仔细检查？为什么？
cards.referenceText: The engines, landing gear, wings, flight-control surfaces, and pitot tubes require careful attention. Each of these areas is important to the aircraft's safe operation, although the entire aircraft should still be inspected thoroughly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机、起落架、机翼、飞行操纵面和空速管需要重点检查。这些区域都关系到飞机安全运行，但整架飞机仍须全面检查。

cards.audioText: Do you think preflight walk around inspection is very important? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行前巡检很重要吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think it's very important for flight safety. We can check if there are any cracks, loosed screws or other hidden trouble in the fuselage. Also, preflight walk around inspection can help us discover problems maintainers didn't see before. We can ensure the security and avoid delay by solving those problems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我认为飞行前绕机检查对飞行安全很重要。我们可以检查机身是否有裂痕、螺丝松动或其它隐患。另外，绕机检查能帮助我们发现维护人员遗漏的问题。我们可以通过解决这些问题来确保安全性并避免延误。

cards.audioText: What should you pay spacial attention to when you perform the walk-around inspection in extreme cold winter weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 在极其寒冷的冬天做饶机检查时，你应该注意什么？
cards.referenceText: When having walk-around inspection in extreme cold winter weather, I will check the airframe to see if there is ice accumulation and we will check the pitot tube to see if they are blocked by ice.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在极其寒冷的冬天做饶机检查时，我们会检查机体是否结冰，皮托管是否被冰堵住。

cards.audioText: What are the walk-around procedures of your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所驾驶飞机的巡检程序有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
The walk-around procedures may vary from one type aircraft to another. I'm flying A320, and we usually inspect the aircraft from the left side of the nose first. Then we'll follow the clockwise direction to check all outside components of the aircraft to ensure that they are all in good conditions. We must make sure
that all the covers and pins have been removed from the aircraft. After finishing the inspection, we'll take the covers and pins to the cockpit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 绕机检查程序因飞机而异。我飞A320，通常我们从机头左侧开始，之后沿顺时针检查机身外部所有部件，以确保它们都处于良好状态。我们必须确认所有的盖板和销已经从机身上移除。完成检查后，我们会把盖板和销带到驾驶舱。

cards.audioText: What do you do during your pre-flight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行前检查时都会做什么？
cards.referenceText: For the exterior of the aircraft, we will check if there is any damage or leakage, the tire and the landing gear. For the interior of the aircraft, we will check the working conditions of systems, for instance, if all systems are at operating conditions, lights are damaged, warning system and display system are normal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对于飞机外部，我们将检查外部是否有任何损坏或泄漏，检查轮胎和起落架。对于飞机内部，我们将检查系统的工作状况，如是否所有系统都处于运行状态、灯光是否损坏、警报系统和显示系统是否工作正常。

cards.audioText: How do you think of preflight inspection of the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎样看待飞行员的飞行前检查？
cards.referenceText: I think preflight inspection of the pilot is just as important as preflight inspection of the aircraft. It is vital to ensure pilots' health at the highest possible level. Having a cold or other illness or taking prescription medicine can seriously affect pilots'ability to concentrate, thus affecting the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为飞行员的飞行前检查和飞机的检查同等重要。在尽可能高的高度飞行，确保飞行员的健康是至关重要的。感冒及其它疾病，或是服用处方药都可能严重地影响飞行员的注意力，从而影响飞行安全。
